_comment: acom-flex-bridge configuration. Everything here is editable from the dashboard Settings panel; restart to apply. Serial port names: COM3-style on Windows, /dev/serial/by-id/... on Linux (stable across reboots), /dev/tty.usbserial-... on macOS.

serial._comment: Serial port wired to the ACOM *CAT/AUX* port (Kenwood CAT). Leave empty and pick it in dashboard Settings. Match baud to the amp's CAT menu (usually 9600 8N1).

telemetry._comment: SECOND serial connection - to the amp's rear-panel *RS-232 remote* port (straight-through TX/RX/GND only; the bridge holds DTR/RTS low so the front-panel power button keeps working). model: 500S/600S/700S/1200S/2020S - sets the PA temperature calibration; tempOffset overrides it if set. keepaliveMs: how often the telemetry-enable telegram is re-sent. allowPowerControl: set false to disable the dashboard's amp Power-Off button. sendAck: optional 0x86 confirmations (not needed in practice). logAllFrames: hex-log every frame for protocol work.

flex._comment: IP of the FlexRadio (give it a DHCP reservation; auto-discovered radios appear in dashboard Settings). enforceAtuBypass: keeps the radio's internal ATU in BYPASS at all times - mandatory with the amp + external tuner in line. preferredClient: optional program or station name to prefer when several GUI clients (SmartSDR, AetherSDR, Maestro) are connected; the dashboard header can also pin one live.

tune._comment: tunePowerDefault: carrier watts when a tune starts (04AT/06AT want 12.5-50 W at the amp input; the amp asks for 20-30). followAmpPowerRequest: PC commands from the amp during tune override the default. maxTuneSeconds: safety carrier drop.

cat._comment: allowFreqWritesFromAmp false = amp frequency writes acked but dropped (kills the post-tune 0 Hz jump). minValidFreqHz: hard floor even if writes enabled. identity 019 = Kenwood TS-2000.

dashboard._comment: Web dashboard + live WebSocket at http://<host>:8990. user/password: optional login - blank password means no login prompt (fine for LAN-only). For access from anywhere, set credentials AND put HTTPS in front - see pi/README-PI.md 'Access from anywhere'. 5 failed logins = 5 minute per-IP lockout. When Caddy fronts the bridge on the same machine, set host to 127.0.0.1 so only Caddy can reach it.

notify._comment: Optional outbound webhook fired when a tune completes/fails - leave blank if the dashboard is all you need. Any URL gets a JSON POST {event, text, freqHz, durationMs, finalSwr, ok}; ntfy.sh URLs get plain-text style automatically.
